page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number top left. One column of verse, full width, in stanzas. Catchword alone at the lower right, below the last line.

l.i: Nereu, parce: Dolor nam satis occupat
Matrum corda suos usque gementium, Qui
(Fas hoc dicere sit, Numine non graui,
Cuius dextra duplex, hoc opus edidit.)
Quàm cum sunt Pharii pondere plumbeo
Nam tunc una fuit gens grauis Isaco.
simul Marti convitium qui facerent patri.
Non aptis, medys currere nec vadis:
Quo non vllus erat, vel sapientior)
Heic, quis crediderit? foemina dux fuit.

page.notes: Catchword "Angusto" is in a larger italic hand at the lower right and is taken as the printed catchword. Lines were joined within each stanza; stanza breaks follow the printed indents. "Iberia" and "Iurata" were given consonant J per rule 5. Possible printing errors left as printed: "medys" (line 4 of stanza 5), "Tomyrin", "Tranant". Words of the first stanza with ambiguous letters were read as printed. The word "Ast" is partly obscured by a stroke and may be read differently.
